title: Lift-and-Cruise Cabin eVTOL
description: A cabin eVTOL study that separates vertical-lift rotors from forward-flight propulsion. This lift-and-cruise arrangement allows each propulsor group to be optimized around a distinct flight phase while preserving a conventional wing for cruise.
